CONFLICT.message: Someone else changed this record. Review the latest version and try again.

DUPLICATE.message: A record with these details already exists.

FORBIDDEN.message: Your role does not allow this action.

NOT_FOUND.message: We couldn't find that record. It may have been removed.

RATE_LIMITED.message: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.

UNAVAILABLE.message: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

UNVERIFIED.message: Confirm your email address to continue.

VALIDATION.message: Some details need attention before this can be saved.
